title: Hide Clues until you want them
body: Start solving with no clues visible. Click Hide Clues to give Babble more room, then Show Clues when you are ready. Reload Clues also brings the page back.

title: Clearer controls between the pages
body: Send to Clues, Send to Babble and the window resize control now share a compact strip between the pages. The arrows follow your layout when you swap sides.

title: Resources start on the left
body: New installations open Resources on the left. Your saved choice is kept. Options now clearly offers Move Resources to Left or Move Resources to Right.

title: Helpful hints settle down after your first session
body: Helpful hints turn off after your first exit following this update. You can turn them back on with Options → Show helpful hints, and that choice is remembered.

title: More reliable word syncing
body: Refreshing Babble waits for your saved words to load before syncing. If saved words are missing from the display after sending, Expert tries to restore them without refreshing the page or losing your chat draft.
